hero.headline: تنور أفغاني في أبو شغارة حتى الثانية فجرًا
hero.intro: مطعم أفغاني على شارع الملك عبدالعزيز في الشارقة بتقييم 4.7 من قرابة 2,000 مراجعة، يذكر زواره التندوري والكباب، وفيه غرف خاصة للعائلات.

reviews.author: Shaikh A.
reviews.text: My family had an amazing dinner last night at Afghan Tandoor Restaurant in Abu Shagara, Sharjah, and the name truly lives up to its reputation. The chicken tandoori, prepared in the traditional tandoor, was incredibly juicy and full of flavor. The mouth-watering kebab…

reviews.author: Gokul R.
reviews.text: Had a great dining experience at Afghan Tandoor where I ordered chapli kebab and the mixed Afghan grill platter with Bukhari rice, everything was absolutely delicious. Good marinated meat and well flovoured rice. A special mention to Shurouk for the excellent and…

reviews.author: Maria M.
reviews.text: I’ve visited Afghan Tandoor many times—probably around ten—and it has become one of my favorite restaurants in sharjha.The food is always delicious, with tender and juicy meat cooked to perfection. Each meal begins with complimentary salad and soup, and they even serve…

reviews.author: Ahtesham A.
reviews.text: Afghan Tandoor is an amazing place for delicious and authentic Afghan food. The flavors are rich, the meat is perfectly tender, and the tandoor aroma makes the food even better. The portions are generous, prices are reasonable, and the service is friendly and quick.…
